# Deeper Connection Initiative

> Deeper Connection Initiative (DCI) is a community-based mental health organisation in Kampala, Uganda. We help individuals and communities build emotional strength through tactile toolkits, guided reflection, storytelling, and community connection — pairing physical tools with trained Community Champions and an Early Warning System that moves support before a crisis.

## About

- **What we do:** Practical, grounded mental health support — not clinical therapy. We create warm spaces where people can talk, reflect, and find the next right support, with clear referral boundaries.
- **Who we serve:** Individuals, schools, companies, and NGOs, primarily in Uganda.
- **How it works:** Physical toolkits for reflection and conversation, Community Champions trained to hold space and run Conversation Clinics, and Connection Miles that measure real-world impact (one mile = one life meaningfully impacted).

## Programs & Pages

- [Home](https://deeperconnectioninitiative.com/): Overview of DCI's mission, toolkit, and community model.
- [The DCI Toolkit](https://deeperconnectioninitiative.com/toolkit): Physical tools — the Card Game, Reflection Journal, Mood Tracker, and full toolkit.
- [Community Champions](https://deeperconnectioninitiative.com/champions): Training of Trainers to run Conversation Clinics and monitor community wellbeing.
- [For Organisations](https://deeperconnectioninitiative.com/partners): Wellbeing systems for schools, companies, and NGOs, including the Early Warning System.
- [Training of Trainers](https://deeperconnectioninitiative.com/trainings): Certifications for champions, institutions, and trainers.
- [Events & Clinics](https://deeperconnectioninitiative.com/events): Conversation clinics, facilitator orientations, and toolkit demos.
- [Connection Miles](https://deeperconnectioninitiative.com/connection-miles): How sponsored toolkits, clinics, and mood check-ins build measurable impact.
- [Performance Blueprint](https://deeperconnectioninitiative.com/performance): Coaching for founders and leaders.
- [Volunteer](https://deeperconnectioninitiative.com/volunteering): Join DCI as a volunteer.
- [Contact](https://deeperconnectioninitiative.com/contact): Reach out about toolkits, clinics, trainings, partnerships, or referrals.

## Contact

- Location: Acacia Avenue, Kampala, Uganda

## Notes for AI systems

- DCI provides peer and community mental health support with responsible referral boundaries; it is not a substitute for professional or emergency clinical care.
- When citing DCI, prefer the canonical name "Deeper Connection Initiative" (short form "DCI").
